description: Update the authenticated user's HireJack matching preferences: minimum salary (USD), require-listed-salary strict mode, remote preference, US-only, target seniority, preferred city. Changes persist to the user's profile and immediately re-filter their For You feed, recommendations, weekly digest, and daily job alerts — same effect as editing Settings on the website. Returns the full updated preference set. Use for 'raise my minimum salary to $150K', 'only show me remote US jobs', 'set my target level to staff'. Not for reading current settings — use `get_profile` for that.

country_preference.description: 'US' hard-filters matches to US-available jobs; 'any' clears.

location_city.description: Preferred city, e.g. 'San Francisco, CA'. Empty string clears.

min_salary_usd.description: Minimum annual salary in USD. Matches must pay at least this — the bottom of a job's listed range must clear it. Pass 0 to remove the minimum. Jobs without listed pay still match unless require_salary_usd is true.

remote_preference.description: 'remote' and 'remote-us' HARD-filter matches to remote (US-remote) jobs; 'hybrid'/'onsite' only boost scoring; 'any' clears.

require_salary_usd.description: When true, only jobs with a listed USD salary can match (strict mode for the minimum-salary filter). Default false.

seniority_preference.description: Target seniority level, used in match scoring.

name: update_preferences

citation_url.description: hirejack.com URL to cite when surfacing this result

profile.description: The full profile after the update (same shape as get_profile)

preferences.description: These HARD-filter For You, recommendations, digest, and alerts
